ast.name: desc
ast.source: Show popup notices from Power Editor. Turn off to keep Obsidian clear, especially on phones.
ast.target: 显示 Power Editor 的弹出通知。关闭后保持 Obsidian 界面清爽，尤其在手机上。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: A rich formatting toolbar at the top of every note in editing view.
ast.target: 在编辑视图中，每篇笔记顶部提供功能丰富的格式工具栏。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Obsidian mobile has its own toolbar, so this is off by default.
ast.target: Obsidian 移动端有自己的工具栏，因此默认关闭。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Replace the commands on Obsidian's above-keyboard mobile toolbar with a note-taking set: photo, dictate, to-do, bullet and numbered lists, indents, bold, and hide keyboard. Turning this off restores your previous arrangement.
ast.target: 将 Obsidian 键盘上方移动端工具栏中的命令替换为一组笔记工具：照片、听写、待办、项目符号和编号列表、缩进、加粗以及隐藏键盘。关闭此选项将恢复您之前的布局。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Drag a button by its grip to reorder it (or focus a grip and use the arrow keys). Add a divider, or go back to the original layout.
ast.target: 通过拖动手柄来重新排列按钮（或聚焦手柄并使用方向键）。添加分隔线，或恢复原始布局。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: A compact formatting bubble appears right at your selection (the fastest way to format).
ast.target: 紧凑的格式气泡会直接出现在您的选区旁（最快的格式设置方式）。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Hover a block for a grip: drag it to move the block, click it for the block menu (turn into, duplicate, copy link, delete…).
ast.target: 将鼠标悬停在块上会出现手柄：拖动它来移动块，点击它打开块菜单（转换、复制、复制链接、删除……）。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Dragging a heading takes everything beneath it (until the next heading of the same level). Turn off to move heading lines alone.
ast.target: 拖动标题会带走其下方的全部内容（直到下一个同级标题）。关闭此选项则仅移动标题行。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Live Preview normally reveals ** and == while the cursor is inside formatted text. This keeps them hidden for a clean look; the markers still exist in the file, you just never see them.
ast.target: 实时预览通常会在光标位于格式化文本内时显示 ** 和 ==。此选项让它们保持隐藏以呈现整洁外观；标记仍然存在于文件中，只是您永远不会看到它们。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Keep a task's checkbox rendered on the line you are editing, instead of showing the raw '- [ ]' the way Live Preview does.
ast.target: 让任务的复选框在您编辑的行上保持渲染，而不是像实时预览那样显示原始的 '- [ ]'。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Ctrl+C also puts formatted text on the clipboard, so a paste into email keeps its headings, bold, links, and lettered sub-lists.
ast.target: Ctrl+C 还会将格式化文本放入剪贴板，因此粘贴到电子邮件中时会保留其标题、加粗、链接和带字母编号的子列表。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: The vertical rule Obsidian draws down each indent level.
ast.target: Obsidian 在每个缩进级别向下绘制的垂直线。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: How much your pages breathe (applies to editing and reading views).
ast.target: 页面的留白程度（适用于编辑和阅读视图）。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: A quiet line under the note's title: “Edited 3 minutes ago”. Click it to swap between the relative time and the exact date.
ast.target: 笔记标题下方一行低调的提示：“3 分钟前编辑”。点击可在相对时间和确切日期之间切换。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Under the note's title, at the very end of the note, or in both places.
ast.target: 在笔记标题下方、笔记的最末尾，或两处都显示。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: The syntax palette for fenced code. The dark ones are the editor themes Claude and ChatGPT render code in.
ast.target: 围栏代码的语法配色方案。深色的是 Claude 和 ChatGPT 渲染代码所用的编辑器主题。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: A numbered gutter down the left of every fenced block.
ast.target: 每个围栏代码块左侧的行号栏。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Style nested numbered lists by level (1, 2, 3 then a, b, c then i, ii, iii) instead of restarting at 1 everywhere. Applies in editing and reading views; the raw number shows while your cursor is on the line.
ast.target: 按层级设置嵌套有序列表的样式（1、2、3，然后是 a、b、c，再是 i、ii、iii），而不是全部从 1 重新开始。适用于编辑和阅读视图；光标位于该行时显示原始数字。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Pasting from Word, Outlook, a web page, or an AI chat converts to clean Markdown automatically, tables included. The 'Paste as clean Markdown' command does it on demand.
ast.target: 从 Word、Outlook、网页或 AI 聊天粘贴时自动转换为干净的 Markdown，包括表格。“粘贴为干净 Markdown”命令可按需执行此操作。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Highlighted or colored text stores HTML in the note. Clean removes those tags when you copy, so other apps get readable text and keep bold and italics. Plain text also drops the Markdown so nothing but the words is left. Off leaves copying to Obsidian.
ast.target: 高亮或带颜色的文本会在笔记中存储 HTML。清理会在复制时移除这些标签，因此其他应用获得可读文本并保留粗体和斜体。纯文本还会丢弃 Markdown，只留下文字。关闭则交由 Obsidian 处理复制。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: A link opens the PDF when you click it, so several of them read as a short list under a heading. An embed draws the pages in the note itself, which suits one document you want to read in place.
ast.target: 链接会在点击时打开 PDF，因此多个链接在标题下看起来就像一份简短的列表。嵌入则直接在笔记中绘制页面，适合你想就地阅读的单个文档。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: PDFs and documents you insert, drag, or paste can sit with the note that talks about them instead of in the vault's one attachment folder. Images are not covered by this and keep going wherever Obsidian already puts them.
ast.target: 你插入、拖入或粘贴的 PDF 和文档可以与提及它们的笔记放在一起，而不是放在库中唯一的附件文件夹里。图片不在此列，仍会存放到 Obsidian 原本放置它们的位置。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: The folder to make beside the note. Write {note} for the note's own name, so each page keeps its files in a folder of its own.
ast.target: 在笔记旁创建的文件夹。用 {note} 表示笔记自身的名称，这样每个页面都会把自己的文件保存在独立的文件夹中。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Dragging a PDF onto a note, or pasting one copied from your computer, files it the way the setting above asks. Turn this off to insert files only from the toolbar, the slash menu, or the command.
ast.target: 将 PDF 拖到笔记上，或粘贴从电脑复制的 PDF，都会按上方设置的方式归档。关闭此选项后，只能通过工具栏、斜杠菜单或命令插入文件。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Checking a box appends a ✅ done date so dashboards can show when things got finished. Recurring items (🔁) always create their next occurrence either way. Query them anywhere with a 'todo' code block.
ast.target: 勾选复选框会追加 ✅ 完成日期，以便仪表盘显示任务完成时间。无论是否勾选，重复项（🔁）都会创建下一次出现。可在任意位置使用 'todo' 代码块查询它们。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Where 'To-do: quick capture' appends new items. The note is created if it doesn't exist.
ast.target: “待办：快速捕捉”将新条目追加到的位置。如果笔记不存在，则会创建该笔记。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: A due-today digest when Obsidian opens, and a notice the minute any '⏰ HH:MM' to-do comes due while the app is running.
ast.target: Obsidian 打开时提供今日到期摘要，并在应用运行期间任何“⏰ HH:MM”待办到期时立即发出通知。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Powers the bubble's AI actions (improve, fix grammar, shorten, summarize). Leave empty to reuse Power Assistant's key automatically.
ast.target: 为气泡的 AI 操作（改进、修正语法、缩短、总结）提供支持。留空可自动复用 Power Assistant 的密钥。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Your own one-click instructions on the AI menu, e.g. "Rewrite as a customer-friendly email".
ast.target: 在 AI 菜单中添加你自己的一键指令，例如“改写为对客户友好的邮件”。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Any OpenAI-compatible base URL, for example Groq. Leave empty to reuse Power Assistant's transcription automatically.
ast.target: 任何兼容 OpenAI 的基础 URL，例如 Groq。留空可自动复用 Power Assistant 的转录设置。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: The key for the endpoint above. Empty is fine for a server on your own machine, or to fall back to Power Assistant's.
ast.target: 用于上述端点的密钥。如果服务器在本地机器上，可以留空；留空也会回退到 Power Assistant 的密钥。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Raw inserts exactly what you said. Tidy removes filler and fixes punctuation; Bullets turns it into a list (both use the AI key). Right-click the mic to switch on the fly.
ast.target: Raw 会原样插入你说的内容。Tidy 会去除填充词并修正标点；Bullets 会将其转换为列表（两者都使用 AI 密钥）。右键点击麦克风可即时切换。
